name: Smith Machine Behind-the-Back Shrug
steps: Face away from the Smith bar at thigh height and take a shoulder-width grip behind you with palms facing back.
Release the hooks and stand tall with your arms straight and the bar close behind your hips.
Shrug your shoulders straight upward toward your ears by contracting your upper traps strongly.
Pause briefly at peak elevation, then lower the bar slowly back to full shoulder stretch before reracking safely.
tips: Move your shoulders strictly straight up and down rather than rolling them forward.
Avoid bending your elbows or leaning forward to force heavier loads upward.
